caption:
You spend too much time formatting rough meeting notes into client proposals. This workflow turns scattered notes into a polished proposal draft in minutes. It uses the Gemini 4 Argon update, which rolled out on October 23, 2026. You do not need new software. You only need the Gemini app and a paid Pro plan.

 Use this exact prompt to structure the output:
"Act as a business consultant. Turn the following raw notes into a clear client proposal. Include project scope, deliverables, timeline, and total cost. Use a professional tone. Keep it under 300 words. Notes: [paste your notes here]"
Review the draft. Send it to the client.

This works best for solo operators who handle sales and delivery alone. The model is fast at structuring text but weak at calculating complex pricing or legal terms. Always verify costs and contract details before sending. Save this for later when you have a new lead.
